messages:
DeployBot: Starting rollout of model-v5.1 to prod canaries (10% traffic) at 2026-03-15T09:25Z :rocket:
DeployBot: Canary health check summary: 5m latency stable, error-rate spiked to 7% on canaries, baseline 0.3% :rotating_light:
IncidentBot: Paging oncall (Maya) for increased canary error-rate on model-v5.1 — severity: potential customer impact. https://incidents.redwood/1932105555
Maya (oncall): Acked. Looking. Can you attach failing request examples?
Zoe (deploy): Adding logs from canary pod (pod-canary-7): ``ERROR: tokenizer mismatch: unknown token id mapping for shard-3`` — repeated 120x in 2m window.
Arjun (eng-sre): Seeing same in infra logs. Also noticed generation truncation and garbage tokens in responses. Likely tokenizer-model artifact mismatch (weights ok but vocab/config drift).
Priya (cs): CS has two paid customers reporting garbled outputs and partial responses. One called in, ticket #4321, says replies are nonsensical for template prompts.
Maya (oncall): Impact looks like degraded output quality for ~10% of requests routed to canaries. Not a full request failure but functional regression. Marking P1 until rollback/mitigation.
Arjun (eng-sre): Quick assessment: v5.1 package includes updated tokenizer.yml that wasn't included in the model bundle for shard-3. The shard resolver fallback returned an older vocab mapping. Reproduction locally with the canary bundle shows token id shift by +2 on some subtokens.
Zoe (deploy): Rolling the canary back to v5.0 for affected hosts. Executing: ``/deploy rollback model-v5.1 --targets canary --to model-v5.0``
DeployBot: Rollback started for canaries. Will report status.
IncidentBot: Handoff to on-call SRE for live mitigation — @Arjun, please coordinate rollback and hotfix.
Arjun (eng-sre): Running validation on previously failing requests against v5.0: outputs match baseline. I'll flip routing to v5.0 for 100% of traffic for a short period to contain impact.
Maya (oncall): Priya, can you confirm CS messaging and whether to send an initial incident advisory to impacted customers?
Priya (cs): Yes — sending a brief heads-up to the two impacted accounts, saying we detected a regression in a recent rollout, we're rolling back and investigating. No broad customer alert yet.
DeployBot: Canary rollback completed on 6 nodes. Health checks green. Error-rate on canaries dropped back to 0.4% within 90s.
Arjun (eng-sre): Mitigation actions:
- disabled auto-weight-sync for the v5.1 release pipeline: ``/infra feature-toggle disable auto-weight-sync v5.1``
- pinned model resolver to avoid shard mix: ``model-resolver pin model-v5.0 --scope prod``
- queued a hotfix build for v5.1 bundle to include correct tokenizer.yml
Please don't re-run v5.1 rollout until patch validated.

Maya (oncall): Confirming customer impact contained. Will keep incident open for postmortem and root cause. Severity downgrade to P2 in 30m if no further issues.
Priya (cs): Sent messages to affected customers. One asked for timeline, I gave ETA: fix & validated build in 2h, full redeploy after validation.
Arjun (eng-sre): Logs + minimal repro snippets uploaded to incident page: https://incidents.redwood/1932105555/attachments (token diffs, sample inputs/outputs). Next steps: reproduce tokenizer assembly in CI, add unit test for shard resolver to catch mismatch.
Zoe (deploy): Added temporary guard: deploy pipeline now validates tokenizer checksum across shards pre-release. Patch PR: https://git.internal/redwood/deploy/pull/812
Maya (oncall): Assigning postmortem to Arjun + Zoe + Priya. Timeline: initial detection 09:25Z, rollback start 09:27Z, rollback done 09:29Z, mitigation toggles 09:35Z.
IncidentBot: Incident severity: P1 -> P2 (mitigated). Next update scheduled in 60m or earlier if status changes. :white_check_mark:
Maya (oncall): Thanks team. Keep thread updated with hotfix validation results, I'll create the incident ticket and link the postmortem draft.
Arjun (eng-sre): Will follow up with a technical summary and a checklist to prevent tokenizer/config drift during model bundle assembly.
Priya (cs): I'll reach back to customers once hotfix validated.
Zoe (deploy): Leaving a note for release engineers: avoid parallel tokenizer edits without cross-checksum step. Adding to release runbook.
Maya (oncall): Closing active mitigation — monitoring for 15m then we'll reassess. :eyes:
